paper_id: SCOPE_ Performance Testing for Serverless Computing
title: SCOPE: Performance Testing for Serverless Computing
motivation: 现有云应用性能测试方法不适用于serverless函数,需要专门方法
problem_framing: 定义性能测试停止准则:结合准确度检查和一致性检查
key_insight: 短时执行的serverless函数需细粒度高精度停止准则,通过置信区间和历史轮次对比判断稳定性
method_signature: 双阶段停止准则:准确度检查(百分位置信区间)+一致性检查(前后轮次都通过)
evaluation_criteria: 97.25%准确率,相比最佳现有技术提升33.83个百分点
evidence_for_taste: not all serverless functions require or benefit from the same level of repetition
using a fixed number of repetitions is unreasonable
performance of most serverless functions follows a non-normal distribution
performance can produce highly fluctuating results even with multiple identical runs
thinking_moves: 指出领域缺乏专用方法,现有技术来自传统云
识别serverless函数独特性能特征(短执行时长、按需触发)
用非参数方法规避分布假设,适合高波动数据
通过双轮次准确度验证缓解单次波动干扰
固定重复次数策略的局限反衬自适应停止准则必要性
cites_own_work: SCOPE builds on their prior work on performance variance analysis (Wen et al., 2023)
